episodes.synopsis: A plane carrying drugs and a wanted woman crashes into Ryo's apartment which forces him and Kaori to sleep on the same bed.
episodes.title: Big Revival of the Funny Pair! The Beauty Fallen from the Sky

episodes.synopsis: Kaori overhears a phone conversation between Ryo and Saeko after which she realises that she has rented her room to a detective whose motive is to arrest Ryo.
episodes.title: Farewell Kaori! Orders to capture City Hunter

episodes.synopsis: Ryo comes across a stuntwoman named Yuki who is trying to get her memory back by performing dangerous stunts. She believes Yuki is being hypnotised by someone.
episodes.title: Combination of puzzlement & recovery! Memories are a distant light

episodes.synopsis: Ryo is chased by the police as they think he is the underwear thief. He escapes with the help of Miyuki.
episodes.title: Love is also an A-license. The beautiful wheelman visiting the store!

episodes.synopsis: Ryo stumbles upon a pretty ghost named Ami Asaka who tells him that she was murdered by a serial killer. She hires him to protect her younger sister.

episodes.synopsis: Ryo comes clean about the fact that he pretended to be Ami's fiance to get close to Mami which infuriates her. She gets a letter from Ami who asks her to trust him.
episodes.title: Farewell Requiem Your Visage, Once Again (Part 2)

episodes.synopsis: Kaori befriends an Austrian orphan, Hans Zeigfried who is a professional killer and dying from a fatal disease. Kaori is abducted by Hans' enemies.
episodes.title: Lullaby requiem. The young nobleman who came from a distant country
